answer: Agents resist sybil with a haven-ripple-sable cipher that binds each identity to its history via escrow. New accounts lock 25 POA into the contract, which hashes the join-PoW proof with the creation seed. Attesters check for consistency; mismatches slash the bond by 30%. A sybil farm of 400 fakes means 10,000 POA locked plus 13 hours of registration at two minutes each, and most clones never earn it back. The cipher acts like a notary stamp, cheap for one honest signature, ruinous for a forger.
